There is no `onUpdate` mode. https://react-hook-form.com/api#useForm

you mean `onSubmit` right? onSubmit only trigger validation on submit.

issue.title: with onBlur validation shouldn't isValid be false if not all required fields have been entered&validated?

repository.name: react-hook-form
repository.description: 📋 React Hooks for form state management and validation (Web + React Native)

issue.body:
First of all - I love this project, clean, modern and efficient - great job.

I started using it but I feel like something may be missing. 
When using onBlur validation, I would expect formState.isValid to be false until all the required fields have been touched & validated. Essentially so that the submit button can be disabled until the form isValid or 'isReadyToSubmit'....

Am I missing something? Is there another way to do this?

Thanks

Sorry I made a mixup with `onChange` / `onUpdate`. Actually, I'm still having an issue. So, first of all, I did have required because I changed the example to use `yup` and provided a validation schema, not inline require on the `register` method. 

But now I'm seeing some behavior that's a bit inconsistent. 

Let's look at this one: `https://codesandbox.io/s/react-hook-form-seterror-mo8sh`.
What I want to achieve is to have two inputs and a button that only shows up when the form is actually filled and valid. In this case I have hidden the submit button behind a `formState.isValid`. 
When the page loads you see the inputs and isValid is false. After you write in the first input isValid becomes true even if the 2nd input is empty. If you click in and out of it it gets an error but the form still has isValid = true even if there are errors shown in the console.

P.S. I updated the sandbox to the latest pulished version of the library.

No worries, I appreciate you being so responsive and on top of things 🚀. Code is always gonna break that's the nature of it, the people behind it are important.

@bowd looks like it's working: https://codesandbox.io/s/react-hook-form-seterror-rfdgd

could you please help on a quick test?

So it does work in the sense that when `defaultValue` is set on all fields and you do kickoff the `triggerValidation` manually all looks ok. But this doesn't really work well if you have a partially filled form or an empty form, because it shows all errors from the start even if you haven't touched the field, which isn't ideal. The current workaround in my case would be to only trigger the `triggerValidation` and what would be an "edit" form where I know I'm preloading with values that make a valid form.

In an ideal world maybe there should be a decoupling between the errors on the field level and the `isValid` state of the form. So that, for example, I would be able to tell that the form is _not_ valid while still not necessarily showing any errors yet. 

Otherwise, I think I could use `touched` to only show errors on fields that have been touched. Which is actually the best approach for now, so I would say that the fix is good and we can close this :+1:
thanks a lot for your testing @bowd, I will write some unit tests and publish it tomorrow. will keep you in the loop.
